title: Awarded the National Scholarship (国家奖学金)
body: I was awarded the National Scholarship, one of China's top national undergraduate honors.

title: Awarded First Prize in CMC (全国大学生数学竞赛)
body: I was awarded First Prize in 17th Chinese Mathematics Competitions for College Students (Non-Mathematics Category A).

title: Joined Tsinghua University
